# Tensor FE Covariance

> Research notes on normalized noise covariance and finite-bit matrix recovery in quadratic tensor functional encryption.

## Established scope

Classical polynomial-time distinction for the specified degree-two family of Cini–Lai–Ünal–Woo, ePrint 2026/1977 (September 11, 2026 version). Uses many valid monomial keys and repeated known-zero encryptions. The gap is 1-negligible under the explicit hypotheses. Also covers the corresponding direct secret-key tensor-preimage assumption experiment.

No claim about ordinary LWE hardness, every allowed parameter choice, higher degrees, or practical attack costs.

## Reading by intention

- Story: [Project bridge](learning/BRIDGE.md), then [Main theorem](science/attack.md) and [Interpretation](science/interpretation.md). The bridge includes a small exact projection example and the steps needed to turn kernel recovery into a decision.
- Study: [Learning index](learning/README.md), [Peikert anchor and notation map](learning/ANCHOR.md), and [30 milestones](learning/MILESTONES.md). The single anchor is A Decade of Lattice Cryptography (2016); the map has 14 background and 16 narrative milestones.
- Theorem and proof dependencies: [Scientific index](science/README.md), then the authoritative topic pages below. The bridge explains these results without replacing their hypotheses.
- Reproduction: [Verification](verification/README.md), followed by python3 verification/run_all.py from the repository root.
- Attribution and prior boundaries: [Related work](references/RELATED_WORK.md) and [Bibliography](references/references.bib).

## Authoritative scientific notes

- [Model](science/model.md): definitions, ciphertext expansion, permitted access.
- [Covariance](science/noise_covariance.md): exact discrete moments and integer Gram recovery.
- [Gaussian measurements](science/gaussian_measurements.md): full affine-lattice law, smoothing and joint RIP before projection.
- [Reconstruction](science/reconstruction.md): rational projection, bounded ellipsoid feasibility, integer rounding and exact decision.
- [Parameters](science/parameters.md): compatible explicit asymptotic family.
- [Theorem](science/attack.md): complete dependencies, resource accounting and probability bound.
- [Interpretation](science/interpretation.md): consequences and limits.
- [Related work](references/RELATED_WORK.md): prior methods and source-access gaps.
- [Verification](verification/README.md): four limited reproducible algebra checks.

The proof uses the actual output marginal of an ideal hidden full-column extension. It does not assume independent coordinates inside a column or independent projected measurement rows after conditioning on the learned projector. The full SDP/ellipsoid procedure is proved, not implemented by the verification scripts.
